plugin.builtin.apache.name: Apache HTTPS Certificate Deployment
plugin.builtin.apache.description: Atomically replace Apache certificates and private keys over SSH, validate configuration, reload the service, and verify HTTPS.
plugin.builtin.synology.name: Synology DSM Certificate Deployment
plugin.builtin.synology.description: Import the certificate, private key, and ordered intermediate chain through the DSM API, then verify the management HTTPS endpoint.
plugin.builtin.nginx.name: NGINX PEM Certificate Deployment
plugin.builtin.nginx.description: Back up and atomically replace NGINX PEM certificates and private keys, validate configuration, reload the service, and verify TLS.
plugin.builtin.iis.name: IIS PFX Certificate Deployment
plugin.builtin.iis.description: Inspect and import a PFX, grant the application pool private-key access, update the IIS HTTPS binding, and verify TLS.
plugin.builtin.rabbitmq.name: RabbitMQ PEM Certificate Deployment
plugin.builtin.rabbitmq.description: Atomically replace RabbitMQ PEM certificates and private keys, restart the service, and verify TLS.
plugin.builtin.java.name: Java PKCS#12 / KeyStore Deployment
plugin.builtin.java.description: Atomically replace the PKCS#12 or KeyStore file used by a Java service and restart the service.
plugin.builtin.windowsService.name: Windows Service Certificate File Deployment
plugin.builtin.windowsService.descriptio: Atomically replace the certificate file consumed by a Windows service and restart the selected service.
